name: Default
shortDescription: Web based music and video streaming server with a web player, Ampache and Subsonic APIs, and a bundled MariaDB database.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated AMPACHE_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. The account is created only on the first start, so change AMPACHE_ADMIN_USER or AMPACHE_ADMIN_EMAIL before deploying if you want different values.
Subsonic clients stream through an internal request that fails behind the HTTPS proxy until you set local_web_path = "http://localhost" in /var/www/config/ampache.cfg.php.
